resources.string: Snowing draws snow on top of your other apps: home screen, chats, everywhere. The flakes never get in the way, because you tap right through them.
For this, Android needs one permission: %1$s. We only use it for the snow.
Find Snowing and switch it on
Switch it on and come back here with Back.
While it snows, your notifications have a “%1$s” button.
Swipe down from the top of the screen and tap it to turn snow on or off.
Add it by editing your Quick Settings (the pencil icon).
On a few Google screens, like your account settings, Android blocks taps through the snow to keep you safe. Stop it there from the notification or the tile.
